content.text: You keep a wiki of skill-selection failures. Read the staged traces. Each trace has the task text, the offered index, the loads, and the ground-truth skill. Write pattern pages named selection-<what happened>, for example selection-missed-heat-when-microwave-mentioned. finish with the four paper fields create_patterns, update_patterns, update_index, append_log. update_index must mention every pattern stem. Do not edit selection-impact, bodies, descriptions, or catalog.

{"proposal": {"create_patterns":[{"name":"selection-nothing-loaded-for-plain-move","content":"# Nothing loaded for a plain single-object move

Traces t1 (phone to dresser), t6 (cloth in drawer) and t7 (keys from desk to safe).
Ground truth was pick_and_place. No skill was loaded in any of them.
The task has no heat, cool, clean, lamp or count word. The pick_and_place entry says to use it for exactly this case.
Fix: when no special verb or count is present, load pick_and_place. Don't load nothing.
"},{"name":"selection-nothing-loaded-for-two-count","content":"# Nothing loaded when the task states two

Traces t3 (two smartphones), t5 (two sets of keys) and t8 (two newspapers).
Ground truth was pick_two_obj_and_place. No skill was loaded.
The count word 'two' is the trigger. It can sit mid-sentence, and the destination can be a safe, a drawer or a stand.
Fix: when the task says two, load pick_two_obj_and_place instead of pick_and_place.
"},{"name":"selection-nothing-loaded-for-clean-with-microwave-destination","content":"# Nothing loaded for clean when a microwave is the destination

Trace t4: 'Put a clean pan in the microwave.' Ground truth was pick_clean_then_place. No skill was loaded.
The word 'microwave' could pull toward pick_heat_then_place, but the task asks for no heating. 'Clean' is the trigger.
Fix: pick the skill by the verb or adjective (clean), not by the appliance named as the destination.
"},{"name":"selection-lamp-examine-task-labeled-pick-and-place","content":"# Lamp-examine wording where the ground truth is pick_and_place

The look_at_obj_in_light description matches this wording, so the label looks surprising. Treat it as a possible ambiguity.
The evidence is one trace, so don't generalize. Note that 'examine ... lamp' does not guarantee look_at_obj_in_light.
The common failure in all 8 traces is that nothing was loaded.
